tasks.short: Investigate control weaknesses, waste, suspected fraud and non-compliance.

steps.what: Set investigation scope and select applicable policies and controls.
Extract transactions and master records within the investigation scope.
Test duplicates, approval limits, unusual spending and control failures.
Inspect invoices, approvals and policy evidence for flagged transactions.

loop.input: Flagged transactions, source documents and selected policy sections.
loop.output: Evidence table with quoted passages, document locations and unresolved gaps.
loop.check: Match identifiers and amounts deterministically; reviewer checks citations and policy relevance.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; unresolved fields go to the auditor.
loop.why_not_simpler: Scanned documents and free-text approvals lack consistent fields; structured records bypass the loop.

steps.what: Discuss exceptions and obtain explanations from process owners.
Assess findings, distinguish errors from suspected misconduct and approve escalation.
Compile approved findings, evidence references and agreed remediation into the report.

tasks.design: A scoped integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reads the {ERP}, {EXPENSE} and {PROCUREMENT}, applies versioned tests and creates an exception register in the {WORKFLOW}. A bounded extraction loop links documentary evidence from the {DOCS}; people conduct interviews and approve findings and escalation. Templates assemble the approved report and remediation records.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data extraction, evidence matching and case tracking required separate integrations and manual workpapers. Rules alone could not establish intent or explain control failures.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding reduces the effort to build connectors, test rules and evidence templates. Bounded extraction can prepare inconsistent documents for review without deciding misconduct.
tasks.still_hard: Collusion, missing evidence and disputed explanations remain difficult. GDPR and applicable EU AI Act duties require assessment; employee monitoring may require consultation or consent under national rules.
tasks.human_edge: People establish context, conduct fair interviews and distinguish suspicious patterns from substantiated findings.

ambition.what: Monthly duplicate-payment and approval-bypass control health review

tasks.altitude: The auditor spends less time assembling evidence and more time testing explanations and remediation. They can prioritize follow-up within their existing mandate; disciplinary and external reporting authority does not expand.

reach.task: Prepare an evidence chronology for a suspected duplicate-payment scheme.
reach.learn: Evidence preservation, interview sequencing and thresholds for referral.

evidence.claim: Rules, scoped extraction and exception registers can automate screening while people determine findings.
DataSnipper supports evidence extraction and tests of details with team review and sign-off.
Hawk provides transaction monitoring with reasons for alerts and four-eye review; this supports the review pattern, not a fraud conclusion.
Dutch works council consent requirements can apply to systems monitoring employee behaviour; national requirements elsewhere vary.

assumptions: The baseline is an internal investigation in a company with separate accounting and operational owners.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured outcomes.
Screening covers explicit controls; it does not claim comprehensive fraud detection.
Consent and access estimates include employee consultation where applicable.
unknowns: Available extraction interfaces and historical record quality.
Whether expense analysis constitutes employee monitoring in the intended deployment.
Investigation authority, escalation thresholds and external reporting obligations.
Existing control tests and evidence retention requirements.
research_questions: Which tests identify useful exceptions in a historical sample without overwhelming reviewers?
How reliably can document references be preserved through extraction and later review?
new_work: Review extracted evidence and resolve unmatched documents.
Investigate false positives and record dispositions.
Maintain control rules, access scopes and evidence retention.
Check that remediation addresses the underlying control weakness.

tasks.short: Review balances, movements and supporting evidence for financial accounts.

steps.what: Retrieve ledger balances, account movements and supporting subledger reports.
Reconcile subledgers, opening balances and account roll-forwards.
Compare balances and movements against prior periods and review thresholds.
Inspect supporting documents for significant balances, estimates and exceptions.

loop.input: Supporting documents and the account balances under review.
loop.output: Source-linked terms, amounts, dates and missing evidence.
loop.check: Recalculate totals, match account identifiers and inspect citations; accountant evaluates accounting implications separately.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; unresolved or conflicting evidence goes to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Contract terms and valuation explanations are unstructured; tabular schedules use deterministic parsing.

steps.what: Obtain explanations for unusual movements and missing support.
Conclude on accounting treatment and approve balance review outcomes.
Record reviewed balances and archive the signed review workpaper.

tasks.design: Scheduled reports from the {ERP} feed deterministic reconciliations on the {DATA_PLATFORM} and an exception view in the {BI}. A bounded loop prepares source-linked evidence from the {DOCS}, while a review record in the {WORKFLOW} captures explanations and approved conclusions. Approved balances feed management reporting; journal posting remains a separate controlled action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reconciliations depended on local account mappings, workbook formulas and manually linked evidence. Estimates and unusual accounting treatments still required professional judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes account-specific reconciliations and source links cheaper to build. Existing reporting and approval configuration can handle retrieval and archiving.
tasks.still_hard: Valuation, impairment, completeness and accounting substance cannot be established by arithmetic alone. Changed account mappings and late adjustments can invalidate earlier review.
tasks.human_edge: The accountant challenges estimates, considers contradictory evidence and decides whether an apparently balanced account is fairly stated.

ambition.what: Weekly review of unresolved balance-sheet exposures

tasks.altitude: The accountant replaces repeated reconciliations with exception investigation and earlier conversations about valuation. They can recommend earlier corrections; posting and material accounting decisions retain existing approval limits.

reach.task: Assess working-capital exposure from aged balances and unresolved reconciliations.
reach.learn: Liquidity implications, estimation uncertainty and escalation thresholds.

evidence.claim: Reconciliations and movement thresholds can use deterministic calculations; accounting conclusions remain judgement.
DataSnipper supports evidence extraction and testing with reviewer sign-off.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported 40–50% savings on tests of details; this vendor case does not establish savings for this entire task.

assumptions: The baseline is a periodic internal account review, not a complete statutory audit.
The {ERP} supports scheduled exports and the {DOCS} supports approval records.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
The retained explanation step benefits from the prepared exception list and evidence.
unknowns: Account mappings, reporting standards and materiality thresholds.
Which reconciliations already run in the {ERP}.
Availability and quality of valuation support.
Access to sensitive supporting records and applicable consultation requirements.
research_questions: Which reconciliations can be configured before writing custom code?
How should late journals reopen previously approved balance reviews?
new_work: Resolve unmatched balances and failed reconciliations.
Review extracted contract and valuation evidence.
Maintain account mappings, thresholds and reporting-period versions.
Reopen reviews affected by late adjustments.

tasks.short: Prepare and discuss management reporting on financial performance.

steps.what: Retrieve reviewed balances, budget figures and prior reporting packs.
Calculate performance measures, budget variances and reporting tables.
Discuss material variances and emerging risks with budget owners.
Assemble tables and write commentary explaining performance and risks.

loop.input: Validated reporting tables, attributed explanations and proposed actions.
loop.output: Commentary with figure references, attributed causes and explicit unresolved questions.
loop.check: Validate numerical references against tables; accountant checks causal claims and proposed actions.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass per pack; unresolved commentary stays blank for the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables use templates, but concise explanations must combine free-text context from several budget owners.

steps.what: Review figures, challenge explanations and approve the management report.
Present financial results and discuss management decisions.
Distribute the approved report and record agreed actions.

tasks.design: Approved data from the {ERP} feeds versioned calculations on the {DATA_PLATFORM}, reporting tables and a {DOCS} template. A bounded loop drafts commentary from attributed explanations, followed by controller approval in the {WORKFLOW}. Approved packs are distributed through the {EMAIL}, and agreed actions enter the {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Metric definitions, workbook links and report layouts differed across teams. Commentary depended on explanations gathered separately from the financial data.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding reduces the effort to standardize calculations and pack generation. Bounded drafting can turn supplied explanations into readable commentary with traceable figures.
tasks.still_hard: Numbers do not prove why performance changed. Conflicting explanations, political pressure and changing metric definitions still require challenge.
tasks.human_edge: The accountant explains uncertainty, challenges convenient narratives and helps managers choose actions they can own.

ambition.what: Monthly financial action brief for first-time budget owners

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends more of the reporting week discussing drivers and following through on actions. They gain capacity to advise smaller budget owners; budget approval rights remain with management.

reach.task: Translate material variances into a revised spending outlook.
reach.learn: Driver-based forecasting, controllable costs and assumptions behind budget-owner commitments.

evidence.claim: Fixed financial metrics and report tables can be generated deterministically; contextual commentary needs supplied explanations and review.
Moody's Credit Memo drafts financial narratives from structured financial information, documents and templates; management reporting is an adjacent application.
The digest's spreadsheet-agent benchmark reports a material cash-waterfall error, supporting independent numerical tie-outs.

assumptions: This task starts with reviewed balances; close and account review are separate tasks.
The baseline includes a recurring internal management pack and discussion.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Controller review becomes shorter through reconciled figures and source references.
unknowns: Which metrics and report layouts management actually uses.
Whether approved budgets and reviewed balances share account and organisational mappings.
Distribution permissions for confidential financial information.
Existing reporting configuration and consultation requirements.
research_questions: Which commentary sections can use fixed templates without a model?
Can reviewers trace every material statement to a figure or attributed explanation?
new_work: Check commentary for unsupported causal claims.
Maintain metric definitions, report templates and distribution permissions.
Resolve data refresh and version conflicts.
Follow up on agreed management actions.

tasks.short: Evaluate financial positions and valuation schedules to determine tax liability.

steps.what: Gather taxpayer balances, asset records and prior tax positions.
Read financing, investment and asset documents for tax-relevant terms.

loop.input: Financing contracts, investment statements and asset valuation reports.
loop.output: Quoted terms, amounts, dates, rate conventions and document references.
loop.check: Match identifiers and amounts; reviewer verifies clauses, rate conventions and missing terms.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; conflicting terms go to the tax specialist.
loop.why_not_simpler: Non-standard contracts contain free-text terms; structured statements use deterministic imports.

steps.what: Determine applicable tax treatments and approve valuation assumptions.
Calculate interest, discounted values, annuities and asset amortization schedules.
Enter adjustments and calculate liability in the tax computation system.
Review liability, reconcile to accounts and approve the tax position.
Prepare the liability memo and archive approved supporting schedules.

tasks.design: A controlled import from the {ERP} prepares tax inputs, while a bounded loop extracts source-linked terms from the {DOCS}. Versioned deterministic valuation schedules use approved assumptions and feed the tax computation system in the {OTHER}. The {WORKFLOW} records treatment and liability approvals, then generates the memo and evidence pack in the {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tax inputs and valuation schedules needed manual mappings and period-specific adjustments. Jurisdiction-dependent interpretation and unsupported assumptions could not safely be reduced to formulas.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding reduces the cost of controlled imports and tested valuation schedules. Existing tax calculation configuration handles arithmetic, while document extraction reduces preparation work.
tasks.still_hard: National tax rules, valuation uncertainty and cross-border arrangements require specialist judgement. Correct formulas cannot compensate for an inappropriate discount rate or tax treatment.
tasks.human_edge: The tax specialist interprets uncertain rules, challenges valuation assumptions and takes responsibility for the defensibility of the position.

ambition.what: Quarterly review of tax exposure from financing and investment changes

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends less time transferring balances and rebuilding schedules, and more time identifying tax-sensitive changes before period-end. They gain capacity to recommend scenarios; authority to approve tax positions stays with the tax lead.

reach.task: Translate an approved liability computation into a filing-ready evidence pack.
reach.learn: Return mappings, jurisdiction-specific disclosures and reconciliation of book and tax values.

reach.task: Compare the tax effects of alternative financing assumptions.
reach.learn: Discount-rate conventions, cash-flow timing and sensitivity analysis.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists with income and corporate tax returns while the user remains responsible.
Interest, discounting, annuity and amortization calculations can use deterministic code once conventions and assumptions are approved.
The digest's spreadsheet-agent benchmark supports checking financial calculations independently of model-generated work.

assumptions: The baseline concerns a business taxpayer; personal tax advice is outside this example.
The {OTHER} is a tax computation system with supported import or configuration facilities.
The task determines liability; submission and payment are separate actions.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Access review includes consultation where national rules require it; employee monitoring is not part of this design.
unknowns: Tax jurisdictions, taxpayer structure and applicable reporting standards.
Supported interfaces and calculation coverage of the tax computation system.
Who approves valuation assumptions and uncertain tax treatments.
Whether source documents contain personal data requiring additional access restrictions.
research_questions: Which schedules are already supported by the tax computation system?
Can historical computations validate timing, rounding and rate conventions?
Which legislative changes require rule updates or renewed specialist approval?
new_work: Verify extracted contractual terms and resolve ambiguities.
Maintain jurisdiction and period versions of calculation rules.
Validate imported balances and book-to-tax reconciliations.
Review sensitive assumptions and record unresolved tax uncertainty.

role.altitude: The week shifts from gathering records and rebuilding workpapers toward investigating exceptions, challenging assumptions and advising decision-makers. Existing approval rights remain unless the organisation explicitly delegates more authority.
reach: Support controllers with earlier visibility of balance-sheet and working-capital exposures.
Support budget analysts with attributed explanations and actionable forecast assumptions.
Support fraud investigators with traceable evidence chronologies.
Support tax preparers with approved computations and organised evidence.
skills_to_grow: Specify deterministic accounting checks and validate their exceptions.
Trace conclusions to source evidence and preserve review history.
Challenge valuation, causal explanations and tax assumptions.
Maintain account mappings, calculation versions and access boundaries.
role.ambitious_version: Provide a recurring financial exposure review that connects unresolved balances, control weaknesses, budget pressures and tax uncertainties to specific management decisions.
